title: Set the real round target, minimum close and lead cheque
description: Replace the placeholder round economics before using allocation metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Round page shows approved target, minimum close, lead target and close date.

title: Turn the 100+ fund universe into a ranked top 20
description: Use thesis, stage, geography, capacity and conflicts to build the working shortlist.
acceptance_criteria: Twenty engageable firms have a sourced access route and target partner role.

title: Screen the top 20 against Loop AI, Voosh AI, Superorder and the full watchlist
description: No outreach begins until portfolio conflict screening is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Every top-20 firm has a dated conflict check with evidence and a resolution.

title: Identify the exact partner who owns the thesis at each top-20 fund
description: Use each fund's scoped LinkedIn search then verify on the firm's team page.
acceptance_criteria: Every top-20 firm has one verified decision-maker contact and source URL.

title: Verify the current fund and close date for the top 20
description: Use the firm's announcement or regulatory filing rather than memory.
acceptance_criteria: Each top-20 fund vehicle has name, close date, size, source and verification status.

title: Confirm check range and lead appetite for the top 20
description: Separate a published initial check from total capital reserved across rounds.
acceptance_criteria: All top-20 firms have sourced min/max or remain explicitly unknown.

title: Map one credible route into each top-10 firm
description: Use warm intros where real; otherwise use the recorded direct or application route.
acceptance_criteria: Each top-10 firm has a route, owner and next action; no fabricated relationship.

title: Run the scoped LinkedIn searches for the top 20
description: Look for partners or GPs currently investing in AI, enterprise SaaS or the relevant vertical.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate names are verified against current firm profiles before saving.

title: Finish the non-confidential one-page teaser
description: Make the wedge, proof and fundraising ask legible without opening the full data room.
acceptance_criteria: Shareable PDF or URL is linked in the data room and marked ready.

title: Finish the investor deck and source every market claim
description: Build the core fundraising narrative for applications and meetings.
acceptance_criteria: Deck is linked, marked ready, and has a version owner and last-updated date.

title: Complete the financial model and round use-of-funds
description: Tie assumptions to customer, pricing and hiring evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Model reconciles to historical actuals and supports the requested runway.

title: Complete the restricted legal and finance data-room set
description: Cap table, incorporation, IP assignment, prior financings and customer contracts.
acceptance_criteria: All restricted checklist items have secure locations and owners.

title: Write the platform-risk and defensibility memo
description: Answer why delivery platforms and marketing suites do not erase the wedge.
acceptance_criteria: Memo includes product boundaries, data advantage, distribution and proof points.

title: Build the first-meeting objection bank
description: Prepare concise evidence-backed responses for market, traction, competition and platform risk.
acceptance_criteria: Every likely objection has a response and evidence reference.

title: Decide whether to apply to the next Y Combinator batch
description: Verify the live deadline and evaluate the standard terms against the round plan.
acceptance_criteria: Decision, rationale, owner and application status are recorded.

title: Decide whether PearX is the right access route
description: Compare the live PearX deadline and program value with direct fundraising.
acceptance_criteria: Decision and rationale are recorded before the verified deadline.

title: Prepare the first five tailored outreach messages
description: Tailor the hook to each firm's thesis and relevant portfolio without oversharing.
acceptance_criteria: Five drafts name the target partner, route, why-us-now and one proof point.

title: Add decision-process questions to the first-meeting script
description: Ask who decides, what gates remain, what references are needed and when a yes/no is possible.
acceptance_criteria: Script captures sponsor, decision makers, gates, timeline and next decision date.

title: Run a weekly fundraising review
description: Review stage movement, stale threads, applications, objections, allocations and blocked work.
acceptance_criteria: Every active firm and open board item has a dated next action and owner.
